metadata.source: PSOC - Azure AD Device Code Authentication.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Azure AD Device Code Authentication
properties.description:
Rule for the Azure Device Code Phishing attacks, which can lead to Azure Account Take-Over (ATO). It leverages Azure AD SignInLogs to detect suspicious authentication requests using the device code authentication protocol. 
This activity is significant as it indicates potential bypassing of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Conditional Access Policies (CAPs) through phishing emails. If confirmed malicious, attackers could gain unauthorized access to Azure AD, Exchange mailboxes, and Outlook Web Application (OWA), leading to potential data breaches and unauthorized data access.
properties.query:
SigninLogs // Filter only successful sign-ins
| where ResultType == 0
| where AuthenticationProtocol == "deviceCode"
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("UserPrincipalName", "")),
    SrcIp = tostring(column_ifexists("IPAddress", "")),
    AppName = tostring(column_ifexists("AppDisplayName", ""))
| where isnotempty(Account)
| where isnotempty(SrcIp)
